verdict.rationale: Bento is an agent tracing and observability product, so masking or redacting sensitive data before it is stored in traces is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence documents masking, redaction, or PII scrubbing. Its OpenTelemetry pipeline support and span tagging are adjacent building blocks, not a redaction capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can mask or redact sensitive data before it is stored in traces
